title: fix(sse): stabilize SSE streaming chunking and framing (partial JSON, delimiter & ordering fixes)
author: Maya Chen
ci_checks: unit-tests: flaky failure on first run -> rerun -> pass
body: Context: We've seen multiple customer reports and internal canary failures where SSE streaming responses could produce malformed framing for partial JSON responses, duplicated event delimiters, or incorrect token/event ordering when the runtime split tokens across chunk boundaries. This caused OpenAI-compatible clients and structured-output consumers to parse incomplete JSON objects and fail or hang. Motivation: stabilize streaming surface across the OpenAI-compat layer and native SDKs so partial JSON payloads, function/tool-calling events, and delimiting events are always emitted in a single coherent event frame. Approach: 1) Consolidate the framing logic into a single deterministic chunker that ensures event boundaries do not split JSON structural tokens ("\,{},[]"). 2) Introduce an explicit "partial-json" continuation marker for cases where an in-flight JSON object must be split; this marker is compatible with our OpenAI-compat adapter and SDK parsers. 3) Ensure token->event ordering is preserved by switching to a single-threaded flush path per-client connection with bounded buffering and backpressure. 4) Add unit/integration tests that replay previous failing canary traces and simulate malformed-split edgecases. Checklist: - [x] Implement deterministic chunker and continuation marker - [x] Update openai_compat streaming adapter parsing expectations - [x] Add unit and integration tests (streaming_test.go, openai_compat/streaming_adapter_test.py) - [x] Run canary against perf-canary traces and validate no regressions - [x] Add migration notes for SDKs to tolerate the continuation marker Related: ENG-4678 (streaming stability), ENG-4720 (openai-compat streaming).
commits: deterministic-sse-chunker: implement chunker that avoids splitting structural JSON tokens
adapter: support "partial-json" continuation marker in openai compatibility adapter
streaming: single-threaded flush path + bounded buffer for per-connection ordering guarantees
tests: add unit/integration tests reproducing canary failures
docs: streaming.md update describing continuation marker and parsing guidance
changed_files: sse/chunker.go: new deterministic chunker and tests
api/openai_compat/streaming_adapter.py: consume/emit continuation marker, parsing fixes
sdk/ts-streaming/parser.ts: tolerate partial-json marker and improved framing logic
docs/streaming.md: documented continuation marker and migration notes
tests/streaming_test.go: unit cases for chunk boundaries
review_discussion: Samir Patel: Found a race when two flush timers fire; suggestion to use single writer per connection to preserve ordering. (comment)
Maya Chen: addressed by switching to single-threaded flush path and added test to cover concurrent flushes. (reply)
Elena Rodriguez: The continuation marker is a good compromise, but can we make it opt-in behind a feature flag? (comment)
Maya Chen: added feature flag `sse.partial_json_continuation` default=true and documented fallback behavior in streaming.md. (reply)
Tobias Klein: small nit - add a test asserting the adapter doesn't accidentally double-emit the delimiter when chunk size == boundary. (comment)
Maya Chen: added test and fixed edge condition in chunker that duplicated delimiters. (reply)
ci_log_summary: Initial CI run: unit test failure (streaming_test.go:TestPartialJsonSplit) reproduced locally; fix applied and rerun -> all checks green. Integration tests validated OpenAI-compat clients. No performance regression observed on perf-canary traces.
release_notes: Fix SSE streaming framing bugs that could split partial JSON objects or emit duplicate delimiters. Introduces a backward-compatible 'partial-json' continuation marker and a feature flag 'sse.partial_json_continuation'. This resolves customer parsing failures for streaming outputs and improves ordering guarantees for token->event emission.
notes_for_release: Ops: no infra changes required. SDK teams: pull parser updates in SDK TS/PY/GO to tolerate continuation marker; patch released in SDK minor. Backwards compatibility: clients that ignore continuation marker will see the same tokens across frames but should update to handle partial-json marker to avoid transient parse errors.
test_plan: Unit tests cover chunk boundary and delimiter duplication cases. Integration tests run end-to-end with openai-compat adapter and sample workloads. Canary run validated against previously failing traces under perf-canary; observed stable parsing and no regressions in latency or throughput.
risk_assessment: Low-medium: changes touch streaming hot path. Mitigation: feature flag rollout, canary verification, additional integration tests, and gradual rollout via routing policy to a subset of hosts for 24h before full rollout.
